summary: @or-sdk/flows preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated bundle
details: Package @or-sdk/flows@2.7.8 declares a `preinstall` hook that runs `node setup.mjs`. `setup.mjs` downloads the Bun runtime binary from `https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v<version>/...`, extracts it to a temp directory, marks it executable, and invokes it via `execFileSync(bunPath, ['math_init.js'])` against a sibling file. `math_init.js` is a 728 KB fully obfuscated Bun-format bundle (`// @bun @bun-cjs`) with a several-thousand-entry mixed string/number constant table and an index-shuffling decoder (`WV8StW`); no readable strings expose its behavior. Both `setup.mjs` and `math_init.js` use obfuscator.io-style identifier naming (`_0xNNNNNN`, `MmgoCP`, `etDiOOB`). The package presents itself as an HTTP client SDK for a flows service, which has no functional need for an alternate JavaScript runtime at install time. Fetching an alternate runtime specifically to execute an obfuscated in-tree bundle at install time — where the bundle's contents cannot be inspected by Node-oriented scanners — is the alternate-runtime dropper pattern; the installer's machine executes opaque code chosen by the publisher immediately on `npm install`.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
